text: In this town, everybody says "hush hush hush" You see, I made a video about the while they were out partying meme and it went viral. Twelve million views, two million likes, forty thousand comments, and every single one just says "hush hush hush." Now everybody says it. The mailman says it when he drops off a letter. The teacher says it when she hands back a test. My grandma says it before every push up. There's even a "hush hush hush" funk remix, and everybody does the dance. Hush hush hush hush hush hush hush.
